Welcome to MyDay

Cardiology Ward

You are a nursing student starting your first shift in your first placement. You arrive at the cardiology ward where you will spend few weeks taking care of the patients. Your dedicated mentor is called Maija and she will guide you through your first day. Before you can enter other rooms and start doing nursing tasks, you need to change into scrubs. You can do that by going to the locker room.

How to playMove around on the map with arrows and use spacebar to enter the room. Or click on the room tile and you'll be taken to the room directly.
